powers.name: of Hollow Steps
powers.text: Every 5th move costs no time and grants {v}% evasion for 2 turns.

powers.name: of the Lantern-Keeper
powers.text: The Lantern of Return has no cooldown while no enemy is in view.

powers.name: of the Bloodied Hem
powers.text: After you take damage, your next 2 moves cost no time. Once per {v} turns.

powers.name: of the Hangman's Knot
powers.text: Enemies that strike you in melee have a {v}% chance to be Rooted for 1 turn.

powers.name: of the Last Candle
powers.text: A hit that leaves you below 20% Life grants a barrier of {v}% of your max Life. Once per 100 turns.

powers.name: of Mourning Bells
powers.text: Every 6th hit stuns the enemies next to your target for 1 turn.

powers.name: of Iron Penance
powers.text: +1% armour for every 1% of Life you are missing, up to {v}%.

powers.name: of Gathering Dusk
powers.text: Each turn you stand still you take {v}% less damage, stacking 3 times; moving ends it.

powers.name: of the Carrion Tithe
powers.text: Your kills have a {v}% chance to drop an extra item.

powers.name: of Thrice-Struck
powers.text: Every 3rd attack on the same target strikes again for {v}% damage.

powers.name: of Cold Hands
powers.text: Your hits have a {v}% chance to Chill the target for 2 turns.

powers.name: of Rusted Mercy
powers.text: +{v}% damage while you are below 30% Life.

powers.name: of the Rooted Oath
powers.text: Critical hits Root the target for 1 turn; +{v}% damage against Rooted enemies.

powers.name: of the Sundered Shield
powers.text: A blocked hit strikes back at the attacker for {v}% of your weapon damage.

powers.name: of the Weeping Saint
powers.text: Drinking a draught also grants +{v}% damage for 10 turns.

powers.name: of Long Shadows
powers.text: +{v}% damage to targets more than 1 tile away.

powers.name: of the Tallow Eye
powers.text: Rare and better items you pick up are revealed at once; +{v} light radius.

powers.name: of the Second Waking
powers.text: A lethal hit leaves you at 1 Life instead. Once per {v} turns.

powers.name: of the Knotted Scourge
powers.text: Your hits make the target Bleed for {v}% of the damage dealt.

powers.name: of the Hammered Nail
powers.text: Every 4th hit stuns the target for 1 turn; +{v}% damage against stunned enemies.

powers.name: of the Chapel Peal
powers.text: When you are hit, a {v}% chance to push every adjacent enemy back 1 tile.

powers.name: of Contrition
powers.text: +{v}% damage while you are below 50% Life.

powers.name: of the Twin Latch
powers.text: Each shot has a {v}% chance to loose a second bolt at another visible enemy in range.

powers.name: of the Silver Nail
powers.text: Bolts pierce along their line, dealing {v}% damage to each enemy after the first.

powers.name: of Salted Bolts
powers.text: Your ranged attacks deal +{v}% damage to the unholy and Slow them for 1 turn.

powers.name: of the Patient Hunter
powers.text: Your first hit on an unaware enemy deals +{v}% damage.

powers.name: of the Sallow Hex
powers.text: Your hits Weaken the target for 3 turns; +{v}% damage against Weakened enemies.

powers.name: of Thorned Whispers
powers.text: Your hits arc for {v}% damage to up to 2 enemies within 2 tiles of the target.

powers.name: of the Moth-Lantern
powers.text: Enemies in view at the start of your turn are Poisoned for 2 turns (each at most once per 3 turns).

powers.name: of the Bleak Vigil
powers.text: An enemy dying within 3 tiles of you grants you {v} barrier, up to 10.
